risks.title: Stock Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Market volatility may limit or prevent investors from readily selling Class A shares and may negatively affect stock liquidity. Past volatility has led to securities class action litigation. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Market volatility can affect the liquidity of Class A shares and limit investor ability to sell, potentially triggering shareholder litigation with substantial defense costs.

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Stockholders may bring lawsuits against the company, which could result in substantial litigation costs and divert management attention. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Potential litigation can result in substantial costs and divert management attention from business operations.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: Despite mitigation efforts, the company cannot eliminate all cybersecurity threats or incidents, which could impact business strategy, operating results or financial position. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Cybersecurity risks can have significant impact on the business and require ongoing mitigation measures.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to extensive regulation in insurance brokerage operations, which may result in regulatory proceedings. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Extensive regulation can impact operations and requires compliance with regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

risks.title: Dividend Distribution Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's ability to declare and pay dividends is limited by Goosehead Financial LLC's capacity to make distributions to the parent holding company. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Dividend distribution is contingent on distributions from subsidiary Goosehead Financial LLC to the parent holding company.

governance.voting_structure: Both classes of common stock have equal voting power with one vote per share
